title.en: Circular-filament vacuum field on a cylindrical grid
title.zh: 柱坐标网格上的圆电流丝真空场

summary: Superpose circular-filament magnetic fields on a uniform radial R-Z grid and integrate R times B_Z radially to obtain the maintained flux convention.

identity.relation: circular-filament currents to axisymmetric vacuum flux and poloidal field on a grid
identity.direction: R-Z grids and [source R, source Z, current] rows -> psi, b_r, b_z
identity.definition: Evaluates elliptic-integral field contributions from each ideal circular filament, sums them, and applies radial trapezoidal quadrature to R times B_Z from the first radial grid point.
identity.geometry: circular sources and a rectilinear cylindrical R-Z target grid
identity.coordinates: SI cylindrical R-Z coordinates; either array axis may be radial
identity.boundary: psi is zero at the first radial grid point; B_R is set to zero for R < 1e-9 m
assumptions: The radial grid is uniformly spaced and strictly increasing.
Each source row carries current in amperes, not a dimensionless Green weight.
The integrated flux is psi=R A_phi relative to the first radial grid point, not complete linked flux 2*pi*psi.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.shape: 2-D, at least two points per axis
inputs.constraints: Finite, nonnegative, rectilinear, uniformly spaced and strictly increasing along exactly one array axis.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.constraints: Finite and rectilinear along the other axis; axial order is not constrained.

inputs.name: filaments
inputs.description: Ideal circular source rows [R0_m, Z0_m, current_A].
inputs.constraints: Finite with strictly positive source radius; an empty source set is allowed; no source may coincide with a target grid point.

outputs.name: psi
outputs.description: Psi=R A_phi from radial trapezoidal integration of R times B_Z, referenced to the first radial grid point.
outputs.constraints: Zero at the first radial grid point; no 2*pi factor is applied.

outputs.name: b_r
outputs.constraints: Forced to zero where R < 1e-9 m.

preconditions: Finite SI inputs on a uniform radial, rectilinear cylindrical grid without source-target coincidence.
supported: Linear vacuum superposition of ideal axisymmetric circular-filament currents on the declared grid.
excluded: Absolute flux reference independent of the first radial grid point.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for invalid grid rank, shape, radial spacing/order, nonfinite values, nonpositive source radius or coincident source and target.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Scientific dependency errors propagate; a nonfinite computed field or flux raises FloatingPointError.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; the field formula and quadrature have no solver iteration.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after validation or computation failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel implementation with internal source-derived development evidence; this document does not assert expert scientific approval of the current version.

example.description: Evaluate one off-grid filament and check the axis limit and radial flux reference.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.field.filament_vacuum_field import integrate_filament_vacuum_field
r_grid, z_grid = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(0.0, 0.3, 5), np.linspace(-0.2, 0.2, 4))
result = integrate_filament_vacuum_field(r_grid, z_grid, [[0.45, -0.1, 1500.0]])
assert set(result) == {'psi', 'b_r', 'b_z'}
assert all(value.shape == r_grid.shape for value in result.values())
assert np.isfinite(result['b_z']).all()
np.testing.assert_array_equal(result['psi'][:, 0], 0.0)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(result['b_r'][:, 0], 0.0)
example.expected: Finite grid-shaped field arrays with zero first-radial-column flux and axis radial field.

scope: Radial quadrature increment and first-grid-point reference.
Comparison with independent circular-filament psi=R A_phi Green values away from the source.
Transposed rectilinear layout and invalid radial grid.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Validated for the maintained ideal-filament grid relation and tested examples; historical candidate evidence does not establish complete source-project closure or expert approval.
known_limitations: The returned flux uses the first radial grid point as reference and omits a 2-pi flux factor.
The ideal source is singular at coincident targets, which are rejected.
Public distribution licensing remains pending a human decision.
